_doc: Evaluation thresholds (evals/run_evals.py; prose in evals/README.md). Each case runs runs_per_case times (1 in quick mode); a case counts a rule as found, or its verdict as matched, when at least case_majority runs agree. Rates are over cases, except invalid_output_rate (over runs, or agent calls for interview and charter suites) and false_finding_rate (findings not in a case's must_find, over all findings of all runs). T2.5: reviewer invalid-output and false-finding limits, the interview and charter limits, all enforced; a metric that can't be calculated fails (fail closed), except recall for a severity the rulebook has no rules of, and a false-finding rate with no findings at all (0 of 0), both stated in the report. min_counts apply only to agents used by a route (config/routes.json). Never lower a threshold to make a run pass.
